headline: Maui Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave

meeting.body: Maui Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave
meeting.summary: The Maui Police Commission voted to place the police chief on paid leave and made the deputy chief acting chief.
meeting.recap: The Maui Police Commission held a special meeting on October 7, 2026.[[0:00:35]] A resident asked that her family's complaint about fireworks damage to their home be included in the commission's investigation.[[0:02:09]] A second resident said the investigation of that complaint has not taken place after nine months.[[0:06:51]] The chair said the chosen investigator has not replied, and the matter will be on the next agenda.[[0:13:50]] A police official said he will review the video footage and report back to the commission.[[0:18:29]] The commission voted 7-0 to create a small budget working group of commissioners.[[0:29:18]] The commission went into executive session, a closed-door discussion.[[1:00:43]] The commission voted to place the police chief on paid leave while its independent investigation is pending.[[1:03:12]] The deputy chief said he would rather the chief not be on leave but will take on the duties.[[1:04:50]] The commission voted 6-0 to make the deputy chief acting chief.[[1:05:33]] The commission voted 6-0 to name an assistant chief as the contact for records the investigator requests.[[1:06:08]] The commission voted 6-0 to make the chair its spokesperson on this matter.[[1:08:05]] The next regular meeting is November 18 at 10 a.m.[[1:08:52]] The October 21 regular meeting is cancelled.[[1:09:05]]
decided: The commission created a budget working group to prepare the commission's budget and review the department's budget.
The commission voted to go into executive session, a closed-door discussion.
The commission placed the police chief on paid administrative leave, effective that day, while its independent investigation is pending.
The commission made the deputy chief acting chief while the chief is on leave.
The commission directed the acting chief to name an assistant chief as the department's contact for records the independent investigator requests.
The commission let the chair send a letter telling the chief of the leave and telling the deputy chief he will be acting chief.
The commission made the chair its spokesperson on this matter.
meeting.next: The chair said he will ask other county investigators if they would take the case. A police official said the department will start an administrative investigation if the review finds wrongdoing. A commissioner offered to write a media release for the commission to review. A commissioner offered to draft replies confirming receipt of complaints, for the full commission to review at the next meeting.

moments.q: Resident testimony on the fireworks complaint
Presentation on public outreach and media communications
Vote to place the police chief on paid leave
Deputy chief responds to the leave decision
